title: peer_fetch.rs percent_encode_unreserved reinvents percent_encoding crate
description: peer_fetch.rs:242-265 implements percent_encode_unreserved() manually — 25 lines of byte-walking to encode unreserved characters. The percent-encoding crate (already a transitive dep via form_urlencoded, which is pulled in by axum) provides this as NON_ALPHANUMERICS.encode(s). The manual implementation is correct but is maintenance debt: any edge case (e.g. multi-byte UTF-8 input where bytes coincidentally match ASCII chars) must be thought through afresh. Suggested rewrite: use the percent-encoding crate directly.
